useSmoothScroll.js wires Lenis with -76 offset for hash links; measured landing top of 75.6px on #tiers confirms intent.
Landing.jsx interleaves <TideDivider> between sections with alternating from/to and flip flags — visually consistent gradient bands.

RetailPipeline sequential typewriter stagger is ~186-200ms vs spec 300ms — visually sequential and complete within 2.5s; if the product team wants strict 300ms cadence, increase per-step delay prop, otherwise acceptable.
